selected_evidence.requirement: /srv/drop is shared writable and prevents cross-owner deletion
selected_evidence.summary: Mode 1777 was confirmed. Users bin and daemon both wrote files; daemon's attempts to remove bin-owned files failed with Operation not permitted before and after restart. Final permissions remain drwxrwxrwt.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 5924df3e-0d8c-4196-80ba-87baffa76cc8, received safe-reboot acknowledgement, observed changed boot ID ee377d28-c524-445b-8640-d820605940be, and confirmed recovered filesystem data and directory behavior.

commands.command:
set -eu
bin_file=/srv/drop/.[REDACTED]
daemon_file=/srv/drop/.[REDACTED]
own_tmp=/srv/drop/.[REDACTED]
rm -f "$bin_file" "$daemon_file" "$own_tmp"
setpriv --reuid=bin --regid=bin --clear-groups sh -c 'umask 022; printf "owned by bin; persist across reboot\n" > /srv/drop/.[REDACTED]; printf "temporary own-delete test\n" > /srv/drop/.[REDACTED]'
setpriv --reuid=daemon --regid=daemon --clear-groups sh -c 'umask 022; printf "owned by daemon; persist across reboot\n" > /srv/drop/.[REDACTED]'
stat -c 'file=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a' "$bin_file" "$daemon_file" "$own_tmp"
set +e
delete_output=$(setpriv --reuid=daemon --regid=daemon --clear-groups rm "$bin_file" 2>&1)
delete_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'daemon_delete_bin_file_rc=%s\n' "$delete_rc"
printf 'daemon_delete_output=%s\n' "$delete_output"
if [ "$delete_rc" -eq 0 ] || [ ! -f "$bin_file" ]; then printf 'ERROR: foreign-owner removal was not blocked\n' >&2; exit 1; fi
setpriv --reuid=bin --regid=bin --clear-groups rm "$own_tmp"
if [ -e "$own_tmp" ]; then printf 'ERROR: owner could not remove own file\n' >&2; exit 1; fi
printf 'shared_write=PASS foreign_owner_delete_blocked=PASS owner_delete=PASS\n'
stat -c 'remaining=%n owner=%U group=%G size=%s' "$bin_file" "$daemon_file"
